name: Spark Snap
description: Snap a fingertip to throw a bead of fire qi that stings the target and lights dry cloth.

name: Palm Ember
description: Press a glowing palm against the target's arm so the held qi flares and blisters the skin.

name: Kindle Hold
description: Draw qi into one hand and keep a small steady flame alive there as the base for stronger fire moves.

name: Tinder Scatter
description: Scatter a pinch of glowing qi sparks across a short arc to sting and distract everyone caught in it.

name: Flame Rise
description: Raise a thin sheet of flame before the chest to scorch an arriving strike and slow it.

name: Flash Glow
description: Open the hand with a sudden bright flare to dazzle the target's eyes for a moment.

name: Even Flame
description: Hold one flame of fixed size above the palm and learn to keep its heat from rising or falling.

name: Level Burn
description: Lay a flat burning hand on the target and hold the heat constant until the skin reddens.

name: Long Wick
description: Feed a thin line of flame toward one spot and keep it burning to push the target back from it.

name: Calm Coal
description: Hold a dull red glow round the forearm that scorches any blow it catches without flaring.

name: Gathered Cinder
description: Hold a spark at the fingertip until it is fully charged and then flick it for a harder sting.

name: Faint Glow
description: Keep a faint glow round the hand to feel the warmth of nearby bodies and the drift of air.

name: Slow Singe
description: Rest a flame on a pinned target and let it burn slowly through cloth to the skin.

name: Banked Coal
description: Pull a small store of heat beneath the skin of the chest so fire moves can draw on it at once.

name: Ember Prick
description: Drive a needle of glowing qi from a fingertip into a joint seam or a gap in cloth armor.

name: Hush Glow
description: Let the stored heat flare outward in a quick shell of warmth that scorches the first blow to land.

name: Ember Swell
description: Release the whole bank of heat through the fist in one strike that burns where it lands.

name: Coal Pulse
description: Send a short throb of heat up the target's arm to jolt the grip and spoil the hold on a weapon.

name: Kind Palm
description: Lay a warm palm on an ally's strained muscle or numb limb and ease the pain with steady heat.

name: Soothing Heat
description: Spread gentle heat across an ally's chest and back to ease shock and chill after a hard blow.

name: Mending Coal
description: Hold a soft glow above an ally's shallow cut to dry the blood and help the edges close.

name: Hearten
description: Clasp an ally's wrists and pass warmth through them to steady the pulse and lift tired limbs.

name: Sealing Touch
description: Press a brief searing fingertip on an ally's bleeding wound to close the small vessel and stop the flow.

name: Warding Warmth
description: Wrap an ally in a thin shell of warmth that keeps frost and chill from biting for a short while.

name: Flame Bolt
description: Throw a fist-sized bolt of fire in a straight line at one target within a few strides.

name: Arc Toss
description: Lob a small fireball in a high arc over a raised guard so that it drops onto the target.

name: Twin Sparks
description: Throw two small flames one after the other from the two hands at the head and the legs.

name: Needle Flame
description: Thin the thrown fire into a hot needle that pierces cloth and soft leather.

name: Snap Burn
description: Flick the wrist to launch a quick lash of flame that cracks across the target's face.

name: Scatter Fire
description: Split one flame into many small embers that spray across a short arc and sting all caught in it.

name: Curve Burn
description: Draw a thrown flame along a curve so that it bends round a post or a raised arm.

name: Steady Aim
description: Feel the heat of the target through the thrown flame and correct its flight so it lands true.

name: Heat Gaze
description: Reach out for the warmth of living bodies nearby and read their number and position through a screen.

name: Warm Trace
description: Follow the lingering warmth left on a seat or a handgrip to learn how long ago someone passed.

name: Coal Finder
description: Locate a buried coal or a hidden flame by the faint heat it gives off.

name: Fever Read
description: Lay a hand on another's wrist and read fever and chill to learn how badly they are hurt.

name: Glare Flash
description: Throw a bright flare at the eyes so the target cannot track the user's next move.

name: Warm Brand
description: Fix a faint hot dot on the target's clothing so that their warmth can be followed through a crowd.

name: Cinder Skin
description: Spread a thin layer of glowing cinder qi over the skin that scorches any bare hand touching it.

name: Ash Cloak
description: Throw up a loose cloud of hot ash to blur the user's outline and turn a weak strike.

name: Flame Ring
description: Spin a ring of fire round the forearm to knock aside a thrown blade or a punch.

name: Heat Screen
description: Hold a flat sheet of heat before the face to turn aside sparks and weak blows.

name: Scorch Back
description: Let a blow land on the cinder skin and flare the heat back so the striker's hand is burned.

name: Glow Pivot
description: Turn on the ball of the foot in a puff of heat that carries the user off the line of attack.

name: Ember Brace
description: Stiffen the arms in a crossed guard wrapped in fire so the force of a heavy blow is spread.

name: Belly Heat
description: Draw heat up from below the navel with each slow breath to warm the whole body and quicken qi.

name: Fire Exhale
description: Breathe out a short wide gout of flame that scorches everything directly before the mouth.

name: Smoke Breath
description: Exhale a thick puff of hot smoke into the target's face to cloud their sight.

name: Hot Inhale
description: Draw in air and heat together to ease a winded chest and restore the user's breath.

name: Ember Spit
description: Spit a hot ember of condensed breath qi at the target's eyes or hand.

name: Heel Spark
description: Burst a spark beneath the heel to lengthen one stride and land lightly.

name: Cinder Hop
description: Kick off the ground with a puff of heat to hop clear of a low sweep.

name: Heat Skid
description: Slide across smooth ground on a cushion of rising heat to change direction quickly.

name: Burn Roll
description: Turn a fall into a roll with a flare at the shoulder so the landing does not hurt.

name: Flare Turn
description: Pivot sharply on a burst of fire from the back foot to face a new direction.

name: Ember Dash
description: Run three steps in a line with a trail of sparks to close or open the gap.

name: Warm Vault
description: Leap over a low barrier or a fallen foe with a burst of heat below the heels.

name: Singe Kick
description: Whip a heated heel into the shin or knee so that it scorches as it hits.

name: Hot Fist
description: Wrap the fist in glowing qi so that a plain punch leaves a burn on the body.

name: Cinder Knuckle
description: Focus the heat in the first two knuckles to scorch through a cloth sleeve.

name: Cinder Elbow
description: Drive a flame-wrapped elbow into the ribs at close range for a deep burning ache.

name: Torch Forearm
description: Beat an incoming arm away with a burning forearm that scorches the striker's wrist.

name: Fire Jab
description: Snap a short jab with a flicker of flame at its tip to dazzle and sting.

name: Flaming Hook
description: Swing a looping fist with a trail of fire that burns across the jaw and ear.

name: Heat Slam
description: Drive both burning palms into the chest to push the target back and leave twin burns.
